title: Rise of Linear Regge Trajectories
summary: A bootstrap extremization principle selects the linear Regge spectrum, with the graviton pole uniquely fixing the trajectory in gravitational theories.

title: Intrinsic Nernst Effect from Berry Curvature in Superconductors
summary: The Nernst effect acts as direct probe of Berry curvature to test topological superconductivity in 2D material with spin-orbit coupling.

title: Valley-Engineered Landau Polaritons in a van der Waals Semiconductor Microcavity
summary: Integrating a WSe monolayer into an optical microcavity generates valley-engineered Landau polaritons, enabling light-mediated valley control of quantum many-body states.

title: Three-Dimensional Electronic Structures in Superconducting Ruddlesden-Popper Bilayer Nickelate Films
summary: Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy of superconducting bilayer nickelate thin films reveals an intrinsic three-dimensional electronic structure and a strong-coupling pairing regime on the orbital band.

title: Interaction-Driven Topological Transitions in Monolayer ${\mathrm{TaIrTe}}_{4}$
summary: Theoretical and experimental mapping of monolayer TaIrTe reveals a rich landscape of interaction-driven topological phases on a single naturally layered crystal—no moiré engineering required.

title: Floquet-Based Ising Machines Escape Local Minima in QUBO Problems
summary: The analog Floquet solver incorporates Floquet amplitude modulations to help it escape local minima, significantly improving the accuracy of parametric oscillator-based Ising machines in solving optimization problems.

title: Candidate for a Fractional Topological Insulator in Twisted ${\mathrm{MoTe}}_{2}$
summary: Pump-probe modulation spectroscopy of a MoTe bilayer superlattice reveals an out-of-plane antiferromagnetic response, providing experimental signatures of a putative fractional topological insulator state.

title: Vast World of Quantum Advantage
summary: Researchers explore quantum advantage across different domains, showing a picture much richer and more nuanced than commonly appreciated.

title: Editorial: Physical Review X at Fifteen
Process Tensor Approaches to Non-Markovian Quantum Dynamics
summary: Researchers review the process tensor framework and demonstrate how efficient tensor-network representations enable the practical simulation of complex, non-Markovian quantum dynamics across diverse physical fields.

title: Dynamics of Quantum Chiral Solitons
summary: A nonperturbative quantization framework for chiral solitons in spin chains demonstrates that they condense into a Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid, appearing as low-energy excitations above the ferromagnetic phase and becoming detectable via inelastic neutron scattering.

title: General Framework Enabling Polarity-Tunable Time-Reversal Symmetric Superconducting Diode Effects in Gate-Defined Homojunctions
summary: Local protonic gating in homojunctions induces a time-reversal symmetric superconducting diode effect, enabling the magnetic-field-free control of nonreciprocal critical currents.

title: Robust Orbital-Selective Flat Bands in Layered Transition-Metal Oxyhalides at Room Temperature
summary: Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy of layered transition-metal oxyhalides reveals intrinsic flat bands that remain stable at room temperature, providing a tunable platform for investigating strongly correlated electron states.

title: Hydroplasticity of Nanocrystal Films Induced by Mesopore Change
summary: A vapor training process allows for improved plasticity and better shaping of wood-derived films.
